body:
The distinct native FP32 packed-scratch candidate is **rejected: 21/22 original conditions**. The sole A1/B1/B2/A2 trial completed once, with the original three internal repeats per family. Whole-call improvements were 16.23%, 37.37%, 3.13% and 29.80%; reverse legacy's 3.13% fails the unchanged 5% minimum. All 16 stage conditions and both Create-plus-all-11-API-window conditions passed.

Original control 8 and all four matched processes passed source/product/provider/ownership checks and complete 32-readback, 51-marker and 54-executed-module joins. Independent review recomputed the rejection from raw native properties. Zero process exit is not benefit acceptance. The remaining seven controls stayed unrun. No production adoption or unchanged retry.

[Complete 403-file evidence commit](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/06fdb5fdd4dfd1b07d2044b4ca5950492143125c/attestations/qualification/5b2df58b/native-packed-scratch-rejected) preserves the actual matched Windows producer, PE/header/object/link-map/CRT proof, raw controls and negative verdict. A 128-lane proposal was also stopped before authoring or compiler work after checking the 64-node layer limit and saved rejection history.

Canonical development remains 5b2df58b. Main, PR #62 and full Mandatory/science/frame/UI/release acceptance are unchanged and unresolved.
